members.title: Police receive further criminal allegations against Russell Brand
members.lead: Met says several people have been in contact since start of disgraced comedian’s rape and sexual assault trial Brand sentenced to more than 10 years in prison for rape and sexual assault Police have received further criminal allegations against Russell Brand since the start of his trial. The Metropolitan police said several people had been in contact during and since the conclusion of the 51-year-old’s rape and sexual assault case. Continue reading...

members.title: Judge who sentenced Russell Brand praised for dispelling rape myths
members.lead: Criminal Bar Association and campaigners hail Mr Justice Bennathan for delivering remarks with ‘piercing clarity’ The judge who sentenced Russell Brand has been praised for dispelling rape myths with “piercing clarity”. Mr Justice Bennathan’s sentencing remarks were particularly welcomed given that rape myths had played a part in the trial. He was also lauded for calling out “enablers” who witnessed sexual assaults by the comedian. Continue reading...
